{{Quote|&hellip;this is my kind of place. A good bar fight waiting to happen!|Thannik, on entering the Dancing Dewback cantina|<ref name="Revised" />}}
'''Thannik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the course of his career, he associated with [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], other bounty hunters, known [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], and other figures on the fringe of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society. A skilled and aggressive fighter, Thannik engaged the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in combat on several occasions. His [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[GT-9R]] and a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Rhen]] frequently accompanied him on his adventures, including a visit to the [[Dancing Dewback]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and a scheme to deliver [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to the Rebel Alliance.

==Biography==
===Visit to the Dancing Dewback===
[[File:Dirk_Harkness.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Thannik worked with Dirk Harkness.]]
Thannik, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Unlike many [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters of the period, he was on friendly terms with the sort of people most hunters considered targets, including several [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and known [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. His adventuring companions included his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[GT-9R]] and a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Rhen]].<ref name="Revised" />

Accompanied by GT-9R, Rhen, the outlaw [[Dirk Harkness]], and a child named [[Cev Rees]], Thannik once visited the [[Dancing Dewback]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to meet with a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] contact. Thannik, though he appreciated the ambiance of the establishment, hung back with his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to assess the situation, keeping an eye out for heavily armed patrons and a path for a quick exit. The rest of his companions, meanwhile, headed directly for the bar.<ref name="Revised" />

===Blaster smuggling===
Thannik accompanied the same group, minus Harkness, during an attempt to smuggle several crates of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to the Rebel Alliance. In the course of this enterprise, they were followed by a group who claimed Thannik and his associates owed them money. These pursuers caught up with Thannik and his companions in an open-air market on a [[Planet/Legends|world]] with a bright blue [[Star/Legends|sun]]. Three of them, led by a tall, cloaked Human, pulled their blasters on the group and demanded their money. Thannik opened fire, wounding the leader, and avoided the return fire. In the meantime, his companions fled to a nearby cantina, where they found themselves surrounded by more armed individuals.<ref name="Revised" />

Thannik was also associated with a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] named [[Drebble]], who once tried to hurriedly fix a [[Power coupling/Legends|power coupling]] on Thannik's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in order to make a quick liftoff. Another known associate was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] bounty hunter named [[Reeveid]], who Thannik once met with in a cantina.<ref name="Revised" />

===Frequent battler===
[[File:Storm-CHRON.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Thannik fought stormtroopers on several occasions.]]
While Thannik's battle experiences sometimes involved vehicular combat, such as attacking his foes with the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] on a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] or firing on a [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] flying overhead, most of these experiences involved close, personal combat. He fought other bounty hunters on at least one occasion, switching from longer-range blaster fire to close combat with a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] in the course of the fight. Similarly, during a fight with a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], Thannik began by using a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], but later switched to an unarmed attack&mdash;namely punching the stormtrooper right in the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|helmet]]. Thannik fought against stormtroopers on several different occasions, once stealing and wearing a suit of stormtrooper [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Revised" />

Thannik was stunned or wounded in battle several times. He was once nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] in battle and required four days' treatment in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] to recover from his wounds.<ref name="Revised" />

==Personality and traits==
In combat, Thannik was aggressive, and not afraid to get into close contact with the enemy. He was comfortable in potentially dangerous places like the Dancing Dewback, where he looked forward to the possibility of a brawl breaking out. This contrasted with several of his companions, such as Rhen and GT-9R, who preferred to stay out of personal combat. On the other hand, he showed caution when entering dangerous situations, in contrast to someone like Cev Rees or Dirk Harkness who would walk right into cantinas without checking for danger first.<ref name="Revised" />

==Skills and abilities==
Like most bounty hunters, Thannik was skilled at searching for hidden objects and individuals. In personal combat, Thannik was a crack shot with a blaster, especially with [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], and at avoiding blaster bolts and other weapons fire. He was a skilled [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] pilot as well, especially when at the controls of [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] models. Thannik also displayed some general expertise on [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]-related subjects.<ref name="Revised" />

Throughout his career, Thannik worked to sharpen his combat and his non-combat skills. As he gained experience, he became a fairly shrewd bargainer and more generally knowledgeable than he was as a rookie. He once upgraded his blaster skills by training with a marksman named [[Hist]] for a week. By the end of the week, Thannik had matched his teacher in skill.<ref name="Revised" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Ghtroc720-SotG07.png|thumb|right|300px|Thannik owned a Ghtroc Class 720 freighter.]]
Thannik, like many bounty hunters, had an extensive arsenal. He carried several blasters, including a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], and a regular blaster pistol. He also used grenades, including [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] such as vibroblades, vibro-axes, and a pair of [[Knife/Legends|combat knives]]. Thannik protected himself in combat by wearing a [[Blast vest/Legends|protective vest]], and carried two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] in case of emergency. A [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and about a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in cash completed Thannik's personal equipment.<ref name="Revised" />

Thannik owned an old Ghtroc [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]], which he acquired second-hand. Though it was in rough shape when he bought it, some of his smuggler friends upgraded it for him. Acquiring this vessel put Thannik at least 5000 credits in debt to a [[loan shark]] on [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]].<ref name="Revised" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Why is he shooting at me?''"<br />"''Maybe it's because ''you're'' shooting at ''them''!|Greg (a player) and Bill (the gamemaster)|<ref name="Revised" />}}
[[File:Tirogcolor.png|thumb|left|300px|Thannik's biography closely resembled that of the bounty hunter Tirog.]]
Thannik is a sample player character appearing in several game play examples in [[Bill Smith]]'s [[1996]] roleplaying game book ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', published by [[West End Games]]. These include examples of group play, skill use, and character creation. Thannik's player "Greg" shares a name with WEG designers [[Greg Farshtey]], [[Greg Costikyan]], or [[Greg Gorden]], while the gamemaster "Bill" shares his name with WEG writers Bill Smith and [[Bill Slavicsek]]. Thannik's game statistics are based on the rulebook's player character template for a Human bounty hunter.<ref name="Revised" />

For the most part, the rulebook examples featuring Thannik are rewritten versions<ref name="Revised" /> of examples previously included in Smith's [[1992]] game book [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]].<ref name="2nd">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> In these reused examples, Thannik replaces<ref name="Revised" /> [[Tirog]], another bounty hunter character played by Greg.<ref name="2nd" /> As a result, Thannik's biography<ref name="Revised" /> closely parallels Tirog's.s<ref name="2nd" /> Two of Thannik's associates, GT-9R and Drebble,<ref name="Revised" /> are companions of Tirog's in the previous rulebook.<ref name="2nd" />

In game play examples related to space combat, Thannik's associate Rhen flies a Class 720 freighter named ''[[Thannik's Thunder]]''. In these examples, Rhen flies ''Thannik's Thunder'' in combat against pirates flying [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] and against Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. In another game play example, ''Thannik's Thunder'' is captured by the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] of an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Revised" />
